name: Estival-Bergschrund
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past asteroid belt proximity, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Whoever controls water controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
